    row = ws.row_values(i)
    mirna_names.append(row[0])
    data_rows.append(row[1:])

print(f"Samples: {len(sample_names)} - {sample_names}")
print(f"miRNAs: {len(mirna_names)}")
print(f"Data: {len(data_rows)} rows x {len(data_rows[0])} cols")

# Check for NAN values
nan_count = 0
for i, row in enumerate(data_rows):
    for j, val in enumerate(row):
        if val == 'NAN' or (isinstance(val, float) and str(val) == 'nan'):
            nan_count += 1
            if nan_count <= 5:
                print(f"  NAN at miRNA={mirna_names[i]}, sample={sample_names[j]}")
print(f"Total NAN values: {nan_count}")

# Create transposed data matrix (samples x miRNAs)

    header = '\t'.join(mirna_names)
    f.write(f"\t{header}\n")
    for j, sample in enumerate(sample_names):
        values = []
        for i in range(len(mirna_names)):
            val = data_rows[i][j]
            if val == 'NAN' or (isinstance(val, float) and str(val) == 'nan'):
                values.append('NA')
            else:
                values.append(str(val))
        f.write(f"{sample}\t" + '\t'.join(values) + '\n')
print("\nData matrix written to /workspace/data_matrix.tsv")

    f.write("sample\tgroup\n")

        f.write(f"{sample}\t{group}\n")
print("Sample metadata written")

# Create variable metadata
with open('/workspace/variable_metadata.tsv', 'w') as f:
    f.write("variable\n")
    for name in mirna_names:
        f.write(f"{name}\n")
print("Variable metadata written")

        lines = f.readlines()
        print(f"{fname}: {len(lines)} lines")
        for i, line in enumerate(lines[:4]):
            print(f"  {line.rstrip()[:120]}")

g2 <- unique_groups[2]

  vals_g1 <- data_mat[groups == g1, i]
  vals_g2 <- data_mat[groups == g2, i]

  vals_g2 <- vals_g2[!is.na(vals_g2)]
  
  if (length(vals_g1) < 3 || length(vals_g2) < 3) {
    raw_p[i] <- NA
    t_stats[i] <- NA

  raw_p[i] <- tt$p.value
  t_stats[i] <- tt$statistic
}

# Apply corrections
bonf_p <- p.adjust(raw_p, method="bonferroni")
by_p <- p.adjust(raw_p, method="BY")

set -eu
cat > run.R << 'RSCRIPT'
# Read data matrix (samples x miRNAs)
data_mat <- read.table(commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)[1], header=TRUE,
                        row.names=1, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE, na.strings="NA")

# Read sample metadata
meta <- read.table(commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)[2], header=TRUE, sep="\t")

# Ensure alignment
stopifnot(all(rownames(data_mat) == meta$sample))

# Get group labels
groups <- meta$group
unique_groups <- unique(groups)
stopifnot(length(unique_groups) == 2)

g1 <- unique_groups[1]
g2 <- unique_groups[2]

mirnas <- colnames(data_mat)
n_tests <- length(mirnas)

raw_p <- numeric(n_tests)
t_stats <- numeric(n_tests)

for (i in seq_len(n_tests)) {
  vals_g1 <- data_mat[groups == g1, i]
  vals_g2 <- data_mat[groups == g2, i]

  # Remove NAs
  vals_g1 <- vals_g1[!is.na(vals_g1)]
  vals_g2 <- vals_g2[!is.na(vals_g2)]

  if (length(vals_g1) < 3 || length(vals_g2) < 3) {
    raw_p[i] <- NA
    t_stats[i] <- NA
    next
  }

  tt <- tryCatch(
    t.test(vals_g1, vals_g2, var.equal=FALSE),
    error = function(e) list(p.value=NA, statistic=NA)
  )
  raw_p[i] <- tt$p.value
  t_stats[i] <- tt$statistic
}

# Apply corrections
bonf_p <- p.adjust(raw_p, method="bonferroni")
by_p <- p.adjust(raw_p, method="BY")

# Build output
result <- data.frame(
  miRNA = mirnas,
  raw_p_value = raw_p,
  t_statistic = t_stats,
  bonferroni_adj_p = bonf_p,
  BY_adj_p = by_p,
  significant_bonferroni = ifelse(!is.na(bonf_p) & bonf_p <= 0.05, "yes", "no"),
  significant_BY = ifelse(!is.na(by_p) & by_p <= 0.05, "yes", "no"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.table(result, file="results.tsv", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE)
